newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore 1997 budget surplus seen at S$4.8 bln.
newsitem.headline: Singapore 1997 budget surplus seen at S$4.8 bln.

text.p: Singapore's budget surplus in fiscal 1997 is estimated at Singapore $4.8 billion, Finance Minister Richard Hu said on Friday.

"Revenue growth in FY97 is not expected to keep pace with the growth of the Singapore economy because of tax cuts introduced to maintain a low and ocmpetitive tax regime. Hence, only a modest budget surplus of S$4.8 billion in projected for FY97, after providing for an increase in development spending," Hu said in his budget announcement.
This is compared with a surplus of S$7.07 billion in fiscal 1996.
